trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low
trades.quote: Long a LBAF of Friday’s low is an A+

trades.name: Long on inability of sellers to reach Friday's low
trades.quote: Getting long on any inability from sellers to get to Friday’s low is an A-. This requires reading a session profile or order flow to have high confidence but I’m generally looking for a session taper anywhere near Friday’s low and I’ll simply have to get long (think nothing but lower wicks from a price action perspective).

trades.name: Long between 29910-29932 and 30001-30028
trades.quote: It is hard to plan for a long between 910-932 and 001-028 and is easier played as a LBAF of Friday’s low as above. However, as mentioned in the commentary, this entire range has potential to be extremely reactive and I need to issue that reminder. If given a reason to get long in this area in between I will do so.

trades.quote: Given Friday’s close, I’ll similarly get long if sellers can’t get back through 104-114, inclusive of a LBAF. I’ll rate this a B/B+

trades.quote: If we trade higher first a see a fail/LAAF of 177-195 I may look for a short but to me any short is a rental until/unless we see traction below at least 29910-29923 and Thursday’s low. C+/B-
trades.stop_hint: any short is a rental until/unless we see traction below at least 29910-29923 and Thursday’s low

trades.name: LAAF of relative equal Thu/Fri highs (possibly 30269-30293)
trades.quote: Short a LAAF of the relative equal highs from Thursday and Friday RTH and Friday premarket, possibly the entire 269-293 weekly level. I’m generally not super enthused about shorts just yet but this is simply too important a spot not to remain open to it. I do think there is a fair chance of seeing at least 177-195 (maybe 206) which makes it a worthy trade, and it has an outside chance of creating meaningful downside. This gets a significant mental downgrade if an active LBAF of Friday’s low is in play.
